cells.row-4-proof|eng-program:
(define (holds? a b)
  (and (= (lerp a b 0) a) (= (lerp a b 1) b)))
(display (map (lambda (c) (apply holds? c))
              (list (list 0 100) (list -5 5) (list 7 7) (list 3/2 9/2))))
(newline)
cells.row-4-proof|math-program:
(define (holds? a b t)
  (= (+ (lerp a b t) (lerp b a t)) (+ a b)))
(display (map (lambda (c) (apply holds? c))
              (list (list 0 10 1/4) (list -4 4 1/2) (list 2 8 2) (list 1 1 1/3))))
(newline)
cells.row-4-proof|cs-program:
(define (holds? a b t)
  (= (lerp a b t) (lerp b a (- 1 t))))
(display (map (lambda (c) (apply holds? c))
              (list (list 0 100 1/4) (list 5 15 1/2) (list -2 2 3/4) (list 0 1 2))))
(newline)
cells.row-5-emergence|eng-composition:
(define (frame-value a b frame total)
  (lerp a b (/ frame total)))
(define (tween a b total)
  (map (lambda (f) (frame-value a b f total))
       (list 0 1 2 3 4)))
(display (list (tween 0 100 4) (tween 10 20 4)))
(newline)
cells.row-5-emergence|math-composition:
(define (mix a b t)
  (lerp a b t))
(define (bilinear tl tr bl br u v)
  (mix (mix tl tr u) (mix bl br u) v))
(display (list (bilinear 0 10 20 30 1/2 1/2) (bilinear 0 0 100 100 1/4 1/5)))
(newline)
cells.row-5-emergence|cs-composition:
(define (safe-mix a b t)
  (lerp a b (clamp t 0 1)))
(define (ramp a b ts)
  (map (lambda (t) (safe-mix a b t)) ts))
(display (list (ramp 0 100 (list -3 1/2 9)) (ramp 4 8 (list 0 1))))
(newline)
